results.title: Could the Anaheim Ducks become Patrik Laine’s next NHL destination after recent contract developments
results.description: Anaheim Ducks reportedly interested in Patrik Laine as Finnish winger seeks NHL opportunity. The Ducks have signed Cutter Gauthier to a contract extension, and Laine reportedly met with Anaheim. While no Laine deal has been announced, the latest development could remove one big piece of the Ducks’ offseason negotiations from the table.
